sourceDistinctions: Spelljammer Scro. Separate from the Orc player profile.

name: Xixchil
printedPages: pp. 15–16 and 24–27. Body Manipulation on pp. 25–26.
sourceDistinctions: Spelljammer player profile. Separate from Thri-kreen and Tosculi.

CGR1 gives no separate movement rate for this player entry, so the build uses standard humanoid movement 12. The printed two-forelimb rule is used for natural attacks. Anesthetic has its own saving throw sentence, with no specified −4 modifier. The build delivers it using the poison delivery modes and treats the bite poison’s fixed damage as additional to the physical bite.
The optional Body Manipulation proficiency is a downtime option and the portrait shows the standard six limbs.
